tools.name: synthesize_circuit
tools.description: Synthesize a deterministic hardware netlist and component modules from a natural language prompt. Supported MCUs: STM32F103, ESP32-C3, ESP32-S3, RP2040, STC89C52, CH32V003, STM32G030, ATmega328P. Peripherals: Type-C, LDO, Crystal, Buttons, LEDs, Buzzer, I2C, RS485, CAN, TP4056 Battery, AHT20 Temp/Humidity Sensor, MPU6050 6-Axis Motion Sensor.

prompt.description: Natural language circuit description, e.g. '基于 CH32V003 的 AHT20 温湿度与 MPU6050 姿态传感器节点'

custom_chip.description: Optional third-party chip definition with custom pinout, package, and peripheral multiplexing rules

tools.name: list_supported_chips
tools.description: List all registered MCU chips and third-party pinout allocation rules (e.g. CH32V003, STM32G030, ATmega328P).

tools.name: register_custom_chip
tools.description: Register or dynamically override a third-party microcontroller pinout and peripheral multiplexing rule.

pins.description: List of available GPIO and power pins

pin_numbers.description: Map of pin names to physical pin numbers, e.g. {'PD1': '8'}

reserved_pins.description: Map of reserved pins and reasons, e.g. {'PD1': 'SWDIO', 'NRST': 'RESET'}

tools.name: search_lcsc_parts
tools.description: Query live LCSC / JLCPCB component inventory, stock, package, and pricing with zero API keys required. Features 24-hour disk cache and exponential backoff.

query.description: Component part number, model, or description (e.g. 'CH340N', 'SP3485', 'TP4056').

limit.description: Maximum number of component matches to return (default: 5).

tools.name: list_circuit_blocks
tools.description: List all 10 pre-validated CircuitBlocks available in the hardware DSL catalog.

tools.name: run_erc
tools.description: Run deterministic Electrical Rules Check (ERC) on a netlist: floating nets, missing GND, unknown designators, missing power domain, missing decoupling. Every finding carries severity + source; blocking/error issues gate BOM/CPL delivery.

netlist.description: Netlist dict with 'connections' (synthesize_circuit output passes directly).

modules.description: Optional modules dict (ref -> {kind, value, package, lcsc}) for component-aware rules.

tools.name: validate_netlist
tools.description: Validate a hardware netlist dictionary against the formal CircuitAgent JSON Schema specification.

netlist.description: Netlist dictionary containing 'connections' list with 'net' and 'points'.

tools.name: calculate_trace_impedance
tools.description: Calculate characteristic impedance (Z0) or differential impedance (Zdiff) for PCB microstrip traces using IPC-2141 / Wheeler equations. Solves exact trace width W and spacing S for target impedance (e.g. 50Ω RF, 90Ω USB, 120Ω RS485/CAN).

mode.description: Trace mode: 'single' for single-ended microstrip, 'differential' for edge-coupled microstrip pair.

target_z.description: Target impedance in ohms (e.g. 50.0 for single-ended, 90.0 for USB differential, 120.0 for CAN/RS485).

dielectric_h_mm.description: Dielectric height between trace and reference ground plane in mm (default: 0.1mm for JLC04161H 4-layer).

trace_thickness_mm.description: Finished copper thickness in mm (default: 0.035mm for 1oz copper).

trace_gap_mm.description: Spacing between differential traces in mm (only used in differential mode, default: 0.15mm).

tools.name: calculate_bom_cost
tools.description: Calculate PCBA component cost breakdown and estimate JLCPCB SMT manufacturing surcharges. Identifies Basic library parts (¥0 feeder fee) vs Extended library parts (+¥20/type feeder fee) and suggests cost optimizations.

queries.description: List of component names, models, or descriptions (e.g. ['STM32F103C8T6', 'SP3485', '0603 10k']).

tools.name: calculate_ipc2152_trace_current
tools.description: Calculate conductor current-carrying capacity or solve required PCB trace width according to IPC-2152 standards for given copper weight (oz), temperature rise (ΔT °C), and layer position.

mode.description: 'solve_current' calculates max Amps for given trace_width_mm; 'solve_width' calculates required mm for target_current_a.

target_current_a.description: Target continuous current in Amperes (required for 'solve_width').

copper_oz.description: Finished copper thickness in ounces (default: 1.0 oz = 35 um).

temp_rise_c.description: Allowable conductor temperature rise above ambient in °C (default: 20.0 °C).

layer.description: Conductor layer position: 'external' (outer copper) or 'internal' (inner plane).

tools.name: audit_industrial_dfx
tools.description: Execute an enterprise-grade DFX (DFM/DFA/DFT/DFC/EMC) compliance audit on a schematic netlist. Verifies optical fiducials (MARK points), ICT testpoint coverage on power/debug rails, IEC 61000-4-2 TVS surge protection on exposed ports (USB, RS485, CAN), reverse polarity protection, and SMT costs.

tools.name: export_kicad_netlist
tools.description: Export standard KiCad S-Expression netlist (.net) compatible with KiCad 6/7/8/9/10 Pcbnew.

netlist.description: Hardware netlist dictionary or synthesis result.

tools.name: export_manufacturing_bom
tools.description: Generate production-ready JLCPCB SMT BOM CSV with part grouping, designator aggregation, and Basic/Extended classification.

netlist.description: Hardware netlist dictionary or synthesis result.

tools.name: calculate_parametric_circuit
tools.description: Solve discrete parametric circuit equations: optimal E96 resistor dividers, LDO thermal dissipation, I2C bus pullups, or RC filters.

type.description: Type of parametric calculation to perform.

params.description: Calculation arguments: for 'resistor_divider' (v_in, v_out_target, max_quiescent_current_ma); for 'ldo_thermal' (v_in, v_out, i_load_a, package); for 'i2c_pullup' (v_cc, bus_capacitance_pf, mode); for 'rc_filter' (cutoff_freq_hz, r_ohm, c_f).

tools.name: render_circuit_topology
tools.description: Render a clean, structured ASCII architectural diagram of power domains, buses, and connected subsystems.

netlist.description: Hardware netlist dictionary or synthesis result.

tools.name: analyze_power_tree
tools.description: Analyze system-level power distribution architecture, load current budgets (typical & peak mA), regulator dropout headroom, and LDO thermal dissipation / junction temperature estimates.

tools.name: calculate_ipc2221_clearance
tools.description: Calculate minimum electrical clearance (conductor spacing) according to IPC-2221B Table 6-1 based on peak voltage and conductor classification (B1 internal, B2 external uncoated, B4 coated, A6 leads).

peak_voltage_v.description: Peak working or test voltage in Volts (e.g., 5.0, 12.0, 24.0, 230.0).

conductor_type.description: Conductor classification: B1 (internal), B2 (external uncoated), B4 (coated), A6 (leads). Default: B2.

tools.name: export_specctra_dsn
tools.description: Generate universal Specctra DSN (v15.0) auto-router interchange file for automated PCB track routing in Freerouting, Cadence Specctra, Altium, or KiCad. Includes heuristic component auto-placement.

trace_width_mm.description: Default routing trace width in mm (default: 0.254 / 10mil).

tools.name: export_kicad_schematic
tools.description: Export modern KiCad 8/9 S-Expression schematic file (.kicad_sch) directly viewable and editable in KiCad Eeschema with sheet layout, component symbols, pin references, and LCSC attributes.

tools.name: audit_supply_chain
tools.description: Audit BOM component multi-sourcing resilience (ISO 9001 supply chain audit), identifying single-source bottlenecks and mapping pin-compatible second-source drop-in replacements with LCSC cross-references.

tools.name: calculate_differential_skew
tools.description: Solve high-speed differential pair intra-pair propagation delay skew (USB 2.0 HS ≤10ps, Ethernet ≤25ps, CAN-FD ≤50ps) and calculate required serpentine length matching tuning bumps count and geometry.

trace_length_delta_mm.description: Measured trace length mismatch in mm (P minus N).

height_mm.description: Dielectric height to reference plane in mm (default: 0.100).

tools.name: export_ipc_d356
tools.description: Generate universal IPC-D-356A ASCII bare-board electrical test netlist file for flying probe testers (AEMG, ATG, MicroCraft) and bed-of-nails PCB fabrication test fixtures.

tools.name: export_gerber_bundle
tools.description: Generate native fabrication-ready Gerber RS-274X layer bundle (Edge_Cuts .gm1, Top Copper .gtl, Top Mask .gts, Top Silkscreen .gto) directly from placed modules and netlist, eliminating GUI EDA dependency.

tools.name: calculate_pcb_stackup_impedance
tools.description: Lookup standard industrial 4-layer (JLC04161H) and 6-layer (JLC06161H) PCB stackup matrices and solve target controlled impedance trace widths (50Ω RF, 90Ω USB, 100Ω Ethernet, 120Ω CAN/485, IPC-2141A).

solve_custom_z_ohms.description: Optional custom single-ended target impedance in Ohms to solve required trace width.

tools.name: export_excellon_drill
tools.description: Generate production IPC-NC-349 Excellon CNC drill file (.drl) with metric tool headers (T01C... T02C...), completing the 5-layer PCB manufacturing bundle for automated CNC drilling machines.

tools.name: generate_interactive_bom
tools.description: Generate a lightweight self-contained single-file Interactive HTML BOM (iBOM, InteractiveHtmlBom-compatible) with interactive component grouping table, vector SVG board map, and bidirectional hover/click inspection.

tools.name: calculate_smt_feeder_matrix
tools.description: Optimize SMT pick-and-place feeder slot allocation (8mm/12mm/16mm/24mm) and nozzle tooling selection (502/503/504/505/506) according to EIA-481 carrier tape standard and OpenPnP/Juki machine matrices.

tools.name: export_openpnp_job
tools.description: Generate production OpenPnP and industrial SMT pick-and-place board job CSV (part, designator, X/Y coords, rotation, nozzle ID, feeder slot assignment) for automated robotic assembly.

tools.name: calculate_ipc7351_land_pattern
tools.description: Calculate mathematically compliant surface mount land pattern geometry (pad width X, pad length Y, pad center distance C, and courtyard boundary bounds) based on IPC-7351B standards across Density Levels A (Most), B (Nominal), and C (Least).

lead_pitch.description: Optional pin center-to-center pitch (mm) for multi-lead packages.

tools.name: calculate_pcb_panel_rails
tools.description: Calculate SMT automated assembly panel frame with breakaway process rails, conveyor clamp clearances, SMEMA tooling holes (NPTH Φ3.2mm), optical fiducials (Φ1.0mm/Φ3.0mm mask), and de-paneling features (V-Cut score lines or perforated mouse-bites) per IPC-2221B Section 8.4 and IPC-SMEMA-9851.

grid_x.description: Number of boards in X direction (default: 2).

grid_y.description: Number of boards in Y direction (default: 2).

rail_width_mm.description: Conveyor clamping rail width in mm (default: 5.0, min: 3.0 per SMEMA).

board_spacing_mm.description: Spacing between individual boards in mm (default: 0 for V-cut, 2.0 for mouse-bites).

tools.name: calculate_ict_testpoints
tools.description: Analyze PCB netlist testability, allocate automated bed-of-nails In-Circuit Test (ICT) testpoints (B.Cu Φ1.0mm), assign probe tip types (crown, spear, serrated), and verify fault coverage percentage per IPC-9252 & IPC-2221B.

min_probe_pitch_mm.description: Minimum probe center-to-center pitch in mm (default: 2.0).

tools.name: calculate_bga_escape_routing
tools.description: Calculate BGA diagonal dogbone via fanout geometry, escape channel trace widths and clearances, and minimum signal layer requirements per IPC-7095 Section 5.2.

ball_pitch_mm.description: BGA ball center-to-center pitch in mm (default: 0.8).

ball_pad_dia_mm.description: BGA solder ball pad diameter in mm (default: 0.4).

via_drill_mm.description: Fanout via drill diameter in mm (default: 0.2).

via_pad_dia_mm.description: Fanout via pad outer diameter in mm (default: 0.45).

trace_width_mm.description: Escape routing neck-down trace width in mm (default: 0.10).

tools.name: calculate_teardrop_reinforcement
tools.description: Calculate tangent teardrop fillets for PCB vias, circular pads, and testpoints to prevent drill breakout, eliminate mechanical/thermal crack stress, and comply with IPC-2221B Section 9.1.5 and IPC-A-600J Class 3.

tools.name: calculate_copper_thieving_balance
tools.description: Calculate layer copper density balance between top and bottom layers, assess reflow thermal bow/twist warpage risk (IPC-TM-650 2.4.22 <= 0.75%), and generate non-functional dummy copper thieving dot/grid patterns per IPC-2221B Section 10.1.1.

top_copper_area_mm2.description: Optional top copper area in mm².

bot_copper_area_mm2.description: Optional bottom copper area in mm².

keepout_margin_mm.description: Keepout margin from board edge in mm (default: 2.0).

tools.name: calculate_via_stitching_array
tools.description: Calculate thermal via matrix array under QFN/power exposed pads (IPC-7093 Section 7.2) or RF ground shielding fence via arrays (IPC-2141A <= lambda/10 pitch) with thermal resistance reduction metrics.

is_rf_shielding_fence.description: Whether to generate dual-side ground shielding fence for RF microstrip (default: false).

tools.name: calculate_serpentine_tuning_geometry
tools.description: Calculate high-speed differential pair serpentine delay tuning meander geometry, ensuring self-coupling suppression (S >= 3W, H >= 3W) and generating vertex paths per IPC-2141A Section 5.3.

delta_length_mm.description: Target added delay length in mm (e.g. 3.5).

tools.name: calculate_stencil_aperture_ratios
tools.description: Evaluate SMT stencil aperture area ratio (>= 0.66 laser-cut) and aspect ratio (>= 1.5) compliance per IPC-7525 Stencil Design Guidelines, identifying paste-release-deficient apertures.

apertures.description: List of apertures ({ref, shape: 'rect'|'circle', width_mm, length_mm}).

tools.name: calculate_fiducial_layout
tools.description: Generate asymmetric 3-point global optical fiducial layout (L-shape, 180° rotation unambiguous) and 2-point local fiducials for fine-pitch components per IPC-2221B Section 12 and JEDEC J-STD-020.

fine_pitch_components.description: Fine-pitch components ({ref, pitch_mm, x_mm, y_mm, half_diagonal_mm}).

edge_clearance_mm.description: Fiducial center clearance from board edge in mm (default: 5.0).

fine_pitch_threshold_mm.description: Component pitch below which local fiducials are required (default: 0.5).
